name: N-acetyl-β-alaninate to H2O
summary: A 7-step route from N-acetyl-β-alaninate to H2O, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: carnosine synthase
reactions.equation: beta-alanine + L-histidine + ATP = carnosine + ADP + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA:m(4)X modification enzyme
reactions.equation: adenosine(4) in tRNA(His) + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methyladenosine(4) in tRNA(His) + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (cytidine(1920)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: cytidine(1920) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(1920) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 16S rRNA (cytidine(1409)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: cytidine(1409) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methylcytidine(1409) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: tRNA (carboxymethyluridine(34)-5-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: 5-(carboxymethyl)uridine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 5-(2-methoxy-2-oxoethyl)uridine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine

reactions.name: 23S rRNA (adenosine(1067)-2'-O)-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: adenosine(1067) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = 2'-O-methyladenosine(1067) in 23S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)

reactions.name: 16S rRNA (guanine(1516)-N(2))-methyltransferase
reactions.equation: guanosine(1516) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = N(2)-methylguanosine(1516) in 16S rRNA + S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine + H(+)
